organization.name_ja: 株式会社NTTマーケティングアクトProCX / NTTビジネスソリューションズ株式会社（NTT西日本グループ）
organization.name_en: NTT Marketing Act ProCX / NTT Business Solutions (NTT West Group)

affected.note: About 9.28 million customer records from 69 client organizations (companies and local governments), per the 2023-12-19 follow-up; first announced as about 9 million from 59 clients. Most files held only names, addresses and phone numbers. ScanNetSecurity reported that a small number of card records were included.

summary.en: A former temporary worker doing operations and maintenance on a call center system that NTT Business Solutions provided to NTT Marketing Act ProCX misused an administrator account to take customer data out and pass it to third parties. About 9.28 million records belonging to 69 client organizations leaked.
summary.ja: NTTビジネスソリューションズがNTTマーケティングアクトProCXに提供するコールセンタシステムの運用保守に従事していた元派遣社員が、管理者アカウントを悪用して顧客情報を持ち出し、第三者に流出させていた。委託元69団体の約928万件の情報が流出した。
